project_title: CR-250 — Mobile First Fold Hero Embedded Compact Form Optimization
theme: Light theme with deep brand accents (#F6F8F5 background, #10B981 brand green, #14201A ink, #F26B33 orange)
viewport_target: Mobile Viewport 375px - 390px First Fold (667px - 844px height max)

typography.h1_mobile: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-[#14201A] leading-[1.12] tracking-tight

mobile_hero_embedded_form.field_input_styling: w-full rounded-xl border border-[#E2E8F0] bg-white px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#14201A] placeholder:text-[#5B6B61]/60 focus:border-[#10B981] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#10B981]/20 outline-none transition-all shadow-sm
mobile_hero_embedded_form.submit_button_styling: w-full bg-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#059669] text-white rounded-xl py-3 text-sm font-semibold shadow-[0_6px_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.28)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
mobile_hero_embedded_form.card_wrapper: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-2xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] backdrop-blur-sm

homepage.hero_structure: Social proof pill badge -> Compact H1 -> Tight Subcopy -> Embedded 3-field DemoForm card -> Swiggy/Zomato/Razorpay/GST Trust Badges
homepage.mobile_fold_rules: On mobile (max-width: 767px), render the 3-field compact inline DemoForm directly below sub-copy. Remove dual 'Book a Free Demo' / 'See Pricing' secondary button overflow. Keep proof pill and trust badges visible within the initial 667px scroll window.

restaurant_pos_system.hero_structure: Category Pill -> Concise H1 -> Stat chips row -> Embedded 3-field DemoForm -> Trust Badges row
restaurant_pos_system.mobile_fold_rules: Embedded hero form directly captures paid search visitors. Replace full-height hero banner image on mobile first fold with the compact 3-field form card.

restaurant_billing_software.hero_structure: Billing Eyebrow -> Tight H1 -> 2-liner sub-copy -> Embedded 3-field Form -> Integration badges
restaurant_billing_software.mobile_fold_rules: Ensure input fields use type='tel' and type='email' for native mobile keyboards. Compact vertical padding py-2 per input.

restaurant_management_software.hero_structure: Eyebrow -> H1 -> Embedded 3-field DemoForm -> Stat badges -> Trust bar
restaurant_management_software.mobile_fold_rules: Mobile viewport padding max py-4 in hero to guarantee form submit CTA button sits above 667px fold line.

cloud_kitchen_pos.hero_structure: Cloud Kitchen Pill -> High Intent H1 -> 3-field Hero Form -> Aggregator Trust Badges
cloud_kitchen_pos.mobile_fold_rules: Direct form embed for fast Swiggy/Zomato brand operator lead capture.

qsr_pos_system.hero_structure: Fast Speed Pill -> Speed H1 -> Embedded 3-field DemoForm -> Trust Badges
qsr_pos_system.mobile_fold_rules: Form card with instant focus or micro submit button 'Get QSR Demo'.

demo_landing.hero_structure: Urgency Eyebrow -> H1 'See MyGenie Live' -> Micro-proof chips -> Embedded 3-field DemoForm card
demo_landing.mobile_fold_rules: Dark background (#10402A) left context panel seamlessly integrates with white form card on mobile viewports.

petpooja_alternative.hero_structure: VSP Headline -> Mobile Stat Chips (₹1L / 40%) -> Embedded 3-field Form in Hero -> Trust Strip
petpooja_alternative.mobile_fold_rules: Comparison competitor page requires form directly embedded in hero section above fold for direct conversion.

restaurant_pos_comparison.hero_structure: Dynamic H1 -> Stat cards row -> Embedded 3-field DemoForm -> Trust strip
restaurant_pos_comparison.mobile_fold_rules: Embed compact hero form directly on competitor comparison page.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft ambient shadow shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] for floating form cards
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/95 for fixed header navigation bar
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Active button state active:scale-[0.98], focus ring ring-2 ring-[#10B981]/20

motion.no_universal_transition: Avoid transition: all globally. Apply targeted CSS transitions on background-color, border-color, shadow, transform.

accessibility.data_testid_required: All input fields, submit buttons, badges, error messages, and form cards MUST contain data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-demo-form', data-testid='demo-input-name', data-testid='demo-submit-btn').
accessibility.input_accessibility: Label associations, aria-required='true', type='tel' for phone, type='email' for email.
accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body and button text against backgrounds.

3d_libraries.recommended: None required for mobile-first fold forms — keep bundle lightweight for instantaneous LCP (<1.5s).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never alter the existing brand colors (#10B981, #059669, #F6F8F5, #14201A, #F26B33, #5B6B61).
Maintain Clash Display for headings and Poppins for body text.
Mobile viewport 375px–390px (667px height) must contain H1, trust badges, and the 3-field compact form in the first fold.
Always preserve all data-testid attributes on interactive elements.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on navigation bars or dropdowns without backdrop-blur.
OTP verification occurs after form submission on a second step/stage, keeping the initial hero form strictly to 3 fields (Name, Phone, Email).
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the 3-field compact form is consistently integrated across the hero sections of all 8 targeted pages. Use shortForm={true} on DemoForm component inside hero containers. Optimize spacing on mobile so that the primary CTA button is immediately visible without scrolling on standard 375x667px mobile screens.
